001package dayplanner;
002
003import java.awt.BorderLayout;
004import java.awt.Color;
005import java.awt.Component;
006import java.awt.Dimension;
007import java.awt.GridLayout;
008import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
009import java.awt.event.ActionListener;
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011
012import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
013import javax.swing.Box;
014import javax.swing.BoxLayout;
015import javax.swing.JButton;
016import javax.swing.JFrame;
017import javax.swing.JLabel;
018import javax.swing.JPanel;
019import javax.swing.JScrollPane;
020import javax.swing.JTextArea;
021import javax.swing.JTextField;
022import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;

024
025/**
026 * Abstract superclass representing a standard DayPlanner GUI window (such as
027 * Add or Search).
028 */
029public abstract class GUIWindow extends JFrame {
030    private static final Dimension DIMS = new Dimension(800, 600);
031    private static final int CLOSE = JFrame.DISPOSE_ON_CLOSE;
032    private static final Color BACKGROUND = new Color(250, 250, 250);
033    private static final Border PADDING = BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(12, 12, 12, 12);
034
035    /**
036     * Reference to the activity list.
037     */
038    public ActivityList activities;
039
040    /**
041     * ArrayList that contains all of the JTextField instances in the center panel.
042     */
043    public ArrayList<JTextField> centerFields = new ArrayList<JTextField>();
044
045    /**
046     * Message box text area.
047     */
048    public JTextArea messages = null;
049
050    /**
051     * Scroll pane containing the message box.
052     */
053    public JScrollPane scrollPane = null;
054
055    /**
056     * The reset button.
057     */
058    public JButton resetButton = null;
059
060    /**
061     * The primary action button (e.g. Add or Search).
062     */
063    public JButton actionButton = null;
064
065    /**
066     * Creates and initializes a new Swing GUI window.
067     * 
068     * @param activities Instantiated ActivityList.
069     */
070    public GUIWindow(ActivityList activities) {
071        super();
072        this.activities = activities;
073
074        setSize(DIMS);
075        setTitle(getWindowTitle());
076        setDefaultCloseOperation(CLOSE);
077        getContentPane().setBackground(BACKGROUND);
078        setLocationRelativeTo(null);
079        setLayout(new BorderLayout(12, 12));
080
081        add(createCenterPanel(), BorderLayout.CENTER);
082        add(createEastPanel(), BorderLayout.EAST);
083        add(createSouthPanel(), BorderLayout.SOUTH);
084        setVisible(true);
085    }
086
087    /**
088     * Creates the center form panel containing input fields.
089     * 
090     * @return Initialized JPanel for center region.
091     */
092    public JPanel createCenterPanel() {
093        String[] labels = getFieldLabels();
094        int rows = labels.length + 2; // +2 for the header rows
095
096        JPanel centerPanel = new JPanel();
097        centerPanel.setLayout(new GridLayout(rows, 2, 8, 8));
098        centerPanel.setBorder(PADDING);
099        centerPanel.add(new JLabel(getHeaderText()));
100        centerPanel.add(Box.createGlue()); // skip this grid cell
101        centerPanel.add(new JLabel(getSubHeaderText()));
102        centerPanel.add(Box.createGlue()); // skip this grid cell
103
104        centerFields.clear();
105        for (String labelText : labels) {
106            centerPanel.add(new JLabel(labelText));
107            JTextField tf = new JTextField();
108            centerPanel.add(tf);
109            centerFields.add(tf);
110        }
111
112        return centerPanel;
113    }
114
115    /**
116     * Creates the east panel containing action buttons.
117     * 
118     * @return Initialized JPanel for east region.
119     */
120    public JPanel createEastPanel() {
121        JPanel eastPanel = new JPanel();
122        eastPanel.setBorder(PADDING);
123        eastPanel.setLayout(new BoxLayout(eastPanel, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
124
125        ActionListener buttonEvent = new ActionListener() {
126            @Override
127            public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent event) {
128                String action = event.getActionCommand();
129                if ("RESET".equals(action)) {
130                    resetFields();
131                } else if (getActionButtonCommand().equals(action)) {
132                    executeAction();
133                }
134            }
135        };
136
137        resetButton = new JButton("Reset");
138        resetButton.setActionCommand("RESET");
139        resetButton.addActionListener(buttonEvent);
140        eastPanel.add(resetButton);
141
142        actionButton = new JButton(getActionButtonLabel());
143        actionButton.setActionCommand(getActionButtonCommand());
144        actionButton.addActionListener(buttonEvent);
145        eastPanel.add(actionButton);
146
147        return eastPanel;
148    }
149
150    /**
151     * Creates the south panel containing the message log display.
152     * 
153     * @return Initialized JPanel for south region.
154     */
155    public JPanel createSouthPanel() {
156        JPanel southPanel = new JPanel();
157        southPanel.setLayout(new BoxLayout(southPanel, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
158        southPanel.setBorder(PADDING);
159
160        JLabel messageLabel = new JLabel("<html><b>Messages:</b></html>");
161        messageLabel.setAlignmentX(Component.LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
162        southPanel.add(messageLabel);
163        southPanel.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(6));
164
165        messages = new JTextArea(5, 40);
166        messages.setEditable(false);
167        messages.setLineWrap(true);
168        messages.setWrapStyleWord(true);
169        messages.setBackground(Color.WHITE);
170
171        scrollPane = new JScrollPane(messages);
172        scrollPane.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(JScrollPane.VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_AS_NEEDED);
173        scrollPane.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(JScrollPane.HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_NEVER);
174        scrollPane.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(760, 100));
175        scrollPane.setMaximumSize(new Dimension(Integer.MAX_VALUE, 110));
176        scrollPane.setAlignmentX(Component.LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
177        southPanel.add(scrollPane);
178
179        return southPanel;
180    }
181
182    /**
183     * Resets all text input fields in the center panel.
184     */
185    public void resetFields() {
186        if (centerFields != null) {
187            for (JTextField tf : centerFields) {
188                tf.setText(null);
189            }
190        }
191    }
192
193    /**
194     * Add a message to the top of the message box and scroll to the top.
195     * Does nothing if the text box hasn't been initialized yet or if the text is blank.
196     * 
197     * @param text Text to add.
198     */
199    public void addMessage(String text) {
200        if (messages == null || text == null || text.isBlank())
201            return;
202
203        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
204        sb.append("> ");
205        sb.append(text);
206        if (!messages.getText().isEmpty()) {
207            sb.append("\n");
208            sb.append(messages.getText());
209        }
210
211        messages.setText(sb.toString());
212        messages.setCaretPosition(0);
213        if (scrollPane != null) {
214            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
215                scrollPane.getVerticalScrollBar().setValue(0);
216            });
217        }
218    }
219
220    /**
221     * Validates and parses a required time string using
222     * {@link Input#parseTime(String)} and
223     * {@link Time#getValidationError(int, int, int, int, int)}.
224     * 
225     * @param timeStr   Raw time string from user input.
226     * @param fieldName Display name of the field (e.g. "Starting time").
227     * @return Parsed {@link Time} instance, or {@code null} if invalid (with error
228     *         added to messages).
229     */
230    public Time parseAndValidateTime(String timeStr, String fieldName) {
231        return parseAndValidateTime(timeStr, fieldName, true);
232    }
233
234    /**
235     * Validates and parses a time string with optional requirement check.
236     * 
237     * @param timeStr   Raw time string from user input.
238     * @param fieldName Display name of the field (e.g. "Starting time").
239     * @param required  Whether the field is required. If false and input is blank,
240     *                  returns null without error.
241     * @return Parsed {@link Time} instance, or {@code null} if invalid or empty.
242     */
243    public Time parseAndValidateTime(String timeStr, String fieldName, boolean required) {
244        if (timeStr == null || timeStr.isBlank()) {
245            if (required)
246                addMessage(fieldName + " cannot be empty. Expected format: YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM.");
247            return null;
248        }
249
250        Time time = Input.parseTime(timeStr);
251        if (time != null)
252            return time;
253
254        String[] components = timeStr.trim().split("[/:,\\s]+");
255        if (components.length < 5) {
256            addMessage("Invalid " + fieldName.toLowerCase() + " format. Expected: YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM (e.g. 2026/09/10 17:30).");
257            return null;
258        }
259
260        try {
261            int y = Integer.parseInt(components[0]);
262            int m = Integer.parseInt(components[1]);
263            int d = Integer.parseInt(components[2]);
264            int h = Integer.parseInt(components[3]);
265            int min = Integer.parseInt(components[4]);
266
267            return new Time(y, m, d, h, min);
268        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
269            addMessage(fieldName + " components must be integers.");
270        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
271            addMessage("Invalid " + fieldName.toLowerCase() + ": " + e.getMessage());
272        }
273
274        return null;
275    }
276
277    /**
278     * Gets the associated ActivityList.
279     * 
280     * @return The ActivityList instance.
281     */
282    public ActivityList getActivities() {
283        return activities;
284    }
285
286    /**
287     * Gets the list of text fields in the center panel.
288     * 
289     * @return ArrayList of JTextFields.
290     */
291    public ArrayList<JTextField> getCenterFields() {
292        return centerFields;
293    }
294
295    /**
296     * Gets the messages text area.
297     * 
298     * @return JTextArea instance.
299     */
300    public JTextArea getMessages() {
301        return messages;
302    }
303
304    /**
305     * Gets the scroll pane for messages.
306     * 
307     * @return JScrollPane instance.
308     */
309    public JScrollPane getScrollPane() {
310        return scrollPane;
311    }
312
313    /**
314     * Gets the reset button.
315     * 
316     * @return JButton instance.
317     */
318    public JButton getResetButton() {
319        return resetButton;
320    }
321
322    /**
323     * Gets the action button.
324     * 
325     * @return JButton instance.
326     */
327    public JButton getActionButton() {
328        return actionButton;
329    }
330
331    /**
332     * Returns the title for this window.
333     * 
334     * @return Window title string.
335     */
336    public abstract String getWindowTitle();
337
338    /**
339     * Returns the header HTML text shown at the top of the form.
340     * 
341     * @return Header label text.
342     */
343    public abstract String getHeaderText();
344
345    /**
346     * Returns the subheader HTML text shown under the header.
347     * 
348     * @return Subheader label text.
349     */
350    public abstract String getSubHeaderText();
351
352    /**
353     * Returns the display text for the primary action button.
354     * 
355     * @return Action button label.
356     */
357    public abstract String getActionButtonLabel();
358
359    /**
360     * Returns the action command string for the primary action button.
361     * 
362     * @return Action button command string.
363     */
364    public abstract String getActionButtonCommand();
365
366    /**
367     * Returns the labels for each form field in the center panel.
368     * 
369     * @return Array of label strings.
370     */
371    public abstract String[] getFieldLabels();
372
373    /**
374     * Executes the primary action when the action button is clicked.
375     * 
376     * @return true if action succeeded, false otherwise.
377     */
378    public abstract boolean executeAction();
379}
